nodes.label: One response per session, not one query (fetch-cache law)
nodes.rationale: Three fetches with three different query strings returned three identical bodies, every destination_url reading back as a prior response, so the cache is pinned per host+path and varying the query string does not move it. Register 1526's rule confirmed at a second endpoint and sharpened: the address is not the scarce thing, the cache-miss is — and a URL M pastes into the conversation breaks it every time.

nodes.label: sremoval=on as the multi-charge ladder parameter
nodes.rationale: It is what gave LADDER-K-Kr.tsv its 495 rows across every ionisation stage; without it the ie.pl query returns one row per element. The URLs were recovered from the transcripts at R 1595, correcting register 1594's claim that a URL was still needed.
